purpose: Exhaustive path-level audit ledger. Registry membership is inventory only. No path is marked reviewed unless every relevant unit and behavior is dispositioned with evidence.
completionRule: All content units, runtime variants and applicable UI states must have evidence-backed dispositions; static path review alone does not establish 100% learner-visible coverage.

surfaces.title: Pattern Forge unified five-stage learning workspace

reviewedUnits.finding: JavaScript head-cursor deque retained expired indices, causing O(n) backing storage despite O(k) auxiliary-space claim.
reviewedUnits.fix: Periodic stale-prefix compaction added; code explanation now states O(n) amortized compaction and O(k) retained index storage.

reviewedUnits.finding: int subtraction for target-value could overflow and create a false complement match.
reviewedUnits.fix: Widened subtraction to long and range-check before narrowing in map and set examples.

reviewedUnits.finding: Static diameter accumulator could retain the previous tree's result across calls.
reviewedUnits.fix: Replaced static field with per-call accumulator and return value.

reviewedUnits.finding: Eight code examples stored escaped backslash-n sequences; the line-numbered DSA UI splits on real newline characters.
reviewedUnits.fix: Normalized source string encoding to actual newlines and added an assertion for each affected example title.

reviewedUnits.finding: Materializing all 2^n subsets could exhaust memory before the bit-width guard was reached.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added caller-supplied maxSubsets cap before allocation and documented Θ(n·2^n) output storage.

reviewedUnits.finding: Search omitted glossary/deep-dive/practice/code explanation content; selection/progress state was not announced; code blocks lacked keyboard focus and explicit explanation association; completion wording overstated self-assessment.
reviewedUnits.fix: Search all lesson content fields, add pressed/expanded/controls semantics, persistent controlled panels, keyboard-focusable labeled code blocks linked to explanations, and honest self-marked completion copy.

reviewedUnits.finding: Prior glossary contained only two terms per module and was thin relative to the concept inventory.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added 92 plain-language term/definition/example entries across 23 modules; 138 total, with per-module uniqueness and required definition/example assertions.

reviewedUnits.finding: DP roadmap previously provided only names/goals without standalone problem statements, examples or hints.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added 20 structured practice briefs with statement, example and hint; wired detail disclosure into the learning UI.

reviewedUnits.finding: Several DP examples used int without bounds, could silently overflow, lacked input/memo guards, and LCS compared UTF-16 char units.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added nonnegative/bounded stair inputs, checked long arithmetic, memo length validation, long grid/knapsack states, code-point LCS, and a split-based interval loop with explicit k<r.
evidence: tests/content-authoring/dp-learning-lab-code-examples.test.mjs: compile and selected runtime boundary cases

reviewedUnits.finding: Practice items were not expandable into statements/examples/hints; completion counts could include stale entries; lesson dots and state controls lacked accessible state/adequate targets.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added problem details, valid-ID deduplicated progress, pressed/expanded states, persistent controlled panels, 44px numbered lesson targets and keyboard-focusable labeled code.

reviewedUnits.finding: Several matrix search and accumulation hints omitted wide product/value midpoints and overflow-safe sums/areas.
reviewedUnits.fix: Clarified long total and midpoint for flattened search, long value bounds for kth/median, padded long difference arrays, long path/area sums and prefix sums.

reviewedUnits.finding: Search omitted complexity/hints and did not trim query; completion count used raw persisted length and hardcoded 42; filter and solved states lacked accessible labels/pressed states.
reviewedUnits.fix: Search all problem fields using trimmed query, count valid deduplicated IDs, derive total from catalog, add select labels/pressed states and persistent controlled details.

reviewedUnits.finding: The 42 matrix problem records lacked concrete example inputs and expected outputs, making them difficult to practice or verify.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added one input/example and expected result to each of the 42 stable problem IDs; UI now displays them in keyboard-focusable example/output blocks.
evidence: tests/content-authoring/matrix-problem-bank-quality.test.mjs: all 42 entries require examples and expected outputs plus selected known-result assertions

reviewedUnits.finding: House Robber state used an inclusive index description/base that did not align with the rolling implementation and the allowed choose-none behavior for empty/all-negative input.
reviewedUnits.fix: Defined dp[i] as the best value from the first i houses, used the prefix recurrence with money[i-1], set dp[0]=0 and clarified that all-negative input returns 0 when choosing none is permitted.
evidence: tests/content-authoring/dp-learning-lab-quality.test.mjs: asserts prefix state, recurrence, base and implementation consistency

reviewedUnits.finding: DP practice could only be filtered by level, and the code header could imply a complete Java program rather than a method snippet.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added full-text search over problem name, goal, statement, example, hint and level; no-match status; renamed code heading to clarify snippets need imports/class context.
evidence: tests/content-authoring/dp-learning-lab-quality.test.mjs: search, status and snippet label assertions

reviewedUnits.finding: Pacific-Atlantic Water Flow sample output omitted coordinate (1,1), which can flow to both oceans in the provided grid.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added (1,1) to the expected result and added a regression assertion.

reviewedUnits.finding: 54 of 55 roadmap topics had no pitfalls and all topics relied on generic fallback practice labels.
reviewedUnits.fix: Added contextual pitfalls and four guided practice prompts derived from each topic's title, subtopics, recognition signal and outcome; explicitly documented these as scaffolds, not a bespoke problem set.
evidence: tests/content-authoring/dsa-roadmap-quality.test.mjs: 55-topic structure, no generic placeholder and contextual prompt assertions

reviewedUnits.finding: Topic outcomes and practice were not visible in the roadmap UI; progress could count stale topic/gate IDs and search omitted outcomes/practice/pitfalls.
reviewedUnits.fix: Render outcomes and guided practice, search all learning dispositions, deduplicate valid progress/gates, expose pressed/current states and label self-marked mastery.

limitations: The DSA structural inventory counts array entries but not semantic correctness or rendered sentence boundaries.
Dynamic/database/generated/user-authored content and UI state variants are not yet fully enumerated.
Focused content and UI units remain awaiting final-head CI; all other registered paths and course units remain unreviewed.
